import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_A = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD_B = 998244353L;

    static final int base = 1000000;
    static long n, order;
    static int answer;
    static int[] partial_sum = new int[maxk];
    static List<Integer>[] sequences = new ArrayList[maxk];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxk; i++) {
            sequences[i] = new ArrayList<>();

    static void generate_sequences(long x, int length) {
        order++;
        long val = ((order - x) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B;
        sequences[length].add((int) val);
        partial_sum[length] = (partial_sum[length] + (int) val) % (int) MOD_A;
        if (length == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            generate_sequences(x * 10 + digit, length + 1);
        }
    }

    static void process(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * base + base - 1 <= n && x * base * 10 > n) {
            long current_order = order;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                int size = sequences[i].size();
                int difference = (int) (((current_order - x * (long) Math.pow(10, i)) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B);
                int position = lowerBound(sequences[i], (int) (MOD_B - difference));
                answer = (int) ((answer + (long) difference * size + partial_sum[i]) % MOD_A);
                answer = (int) ((answer - (long) MOD_A * (size - position) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A);
                order += size;

            return;

        order++;
        answer = (int) ((answer + ((order - x) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B) % MOD_A);
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            process(x * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
